title: Create src/tui/components/FeatureDiffPreview.tsx — diff preview TUI
description: Create an Ink component that shows a preview of PRD changes and new tasks before applying them. Provides Yes/Edit/Cancel selection prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: FeatureDiffPreview renders specMarkdown lines with green '+' prefix
New tasks list shows all tasks with IDs and titles

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text from ink. Import SelectInput. Define props: { specMarkdown: string; tasks: Task[]; onApply: () => void; onEdit: () => void; onCancel: () => void }
Show spec lines with green '+' prefix: {specMarkdown.split('\n').slice(0, 20).map((line, i) => <Text key={i} color='green'>+ {line}</Text>)}. Truncate to 20 lines if too long, show '...' indicator.
Below the diff: <Text bold>New Tasks ({tasks.length}):</Text>{tasks.map((t, i) => <Text key={i}>  #{i+1} {t.title}</Text>)}

Add SelectInput with three items: [{ label: 'Yes — apply changes', value: 'apply' }, { label: 'Edit — open in $EDITOR', value: 'edit' }, { label: 'Cancel', value: 'cancel' }]. Call the appropriate callback based on selection.
